title: Incident Response Analyst (DFIR)
summary: An incident response analyst investigates confirmed security breaches, works out what the attacker did and helps contain and clean up. DFIR stands for digital forensics and incident response; the role sits above the SOC (security operations centre) and steps in when an alert turns into a real incident.
dailyDuties: Contain, investigate and close security incidents using a structured process
Collect disk, memory and log evidence and build attack timelines
Search and correlate logs in the SIEM during investigations
Isolate and investigate hosts with EDR tools
Triage suspicious files in a sandbox and pull out indicators
Map attacker activity to MITRE ATT&CK and hunt for related activity
Write incident reports and support CERT-In breach reporting

skills.expectation: Contain, investigate and close security incidents using a structured process
Collect and analyse disk, memory and log evidence and build timelines
Search and correlate logs across sources during investigations
Use EDR tools to investigate and isolate hosts
Triage suspicious files in a sandbox and pull out indicators
Map attacker activity to MITRE ATT&CK and hunt for related activity
Read network traffic and logs to trace attacker movement
Write clear incident reports and brief stakeholders under pressure
Enrich indicators and track threat actors
Support breach notification, including CERT-In reporting timelines

certifications.why: The incident-handling certificate Indian IR listings name most often
Proves deep forensic analysis for incident response.
